text: The Official Campus Comic presents... Lightbulb Moment!
TWIST!

Dear all, Greetings from the Office of the Official Narrator. This is to inform you that the Official Campus Comic has run for four thousand pages without a single twist, with the continuous support of the institute. Freshers are reminded of the eleven P. M. induction curfew. Nobody will follow it. P.S. The T. A.s of this comic (me) requested a salary hike. Management has replied: no. That's fine. I'm fine. What could possibly go wrong? Regards. BOHN-daa!
Welcome to the Official Campus Comic (Approved). Every page has already been printed. That's the ORIGINAL story.
You're Bulby, the only working bulb in O. B. H.. Characters only act when they're in your light, and each one does what its thought bubble says.
Your goal: change who's lit and what they think, so the page ends with the TWIST written in red pen. The grey pencil lines are fine-tunes for extra stars.
One star for the twist, more for the fine-tunes, and collect every ending. Let's start with Bir-YAA-nee Sunday...

Sunday. Bir-YAA-nee Day at kuh-DUM-baa, the one day there's no PUP-poo in it. Every Sunday for eleven years, CHIN-too the campus dog has eaten the bir-YAA-nee. CHIN-too does not refuse literally anything. DUSS-ee does not eat bir-YAA-nee. DUSS-ee has seen what is IN the bir-YAA-nee.
CHIN-too ate the bir-YAA-nee. Frog and all. A classic.
DUSS-ee ate the bir-YAA-nee.
DUSS-ee ate the bir-YAA-nee. Ten C. G. P. A., never touches mess food. Who moved my lamp? Somebody MOVED my LAMP.
And CHIN-too ran out of the comic. The dog who eats everything has refused something. Write it down. History.
CHIN-too ate the bir-YAA-nee. As per policy.
Ah, the classics. Like the mess menu.
Wrong Answer on test 1. Lovely.
I have a ten C. G. P. A.. I KNOW what's in that bir-YAA-nee.
Actually... a ten C. G. P. A. needs protein.
Write it down, Narrator. DUSS-ee. Ate. The. Bir-YAA-nee.
Bir-YAA-nee bir-YAA-nee bir-YAA-nee.
Something in there just did an okay sign at me.
Bir-YAA-nee.

Monday. Today's kuh-DUM-baa menu: to-MAA-to PUP-poo. Also Daal PUP-poo, PAA-luck PUP-poo, PUP-poo Rice, and for dessert, a sweet PUP-poo. One bowl of to-MAA-to PUP-poo has sat on that counter since 2009. Everyone is scared of the PUP-poo. The PUP-poo is scared of nobody. Also new this week: Prompt bh-EYE, registered for all fourteen in-FIN-ee-um events. Chat G. P. T. filled in the form. The quiz and the hackathon start at the same time. He's in both.
Nobody ate anything. Everyone stared at the PUP-poo. The PUP-poo stared back. I call this suspense.
The SAAHNP ate the PUP-poo.
The SAAHNP ate the PUP-poo. Voluntarily. And now he says he 'didn't even eat that much'. Somebody check him for a fever. Somebody check the PUP-poo for a fever.
And CHIN-too fled the mess. The one dog who eats everything has drawn a line. The line is PUP-poo.
And Mess AAN-tee fled her own mess. She made it. She knows.
The PUP-poo survives another semester.
The PUP-poo remains uneaten. As it has since 2009.
Wrong Answer on test 2. The PUP-poo thanks you.
Prompt bh-EYE fled too. He asked Claude what was in the PUP-poo. Claude asked for more context. There is no more context. It's PUP-poo.
Bro, I'm not scared of PUP-poo. I just didn't study the PUP-poo.
Fine. I'll eat it. I won't even like it. I'll top it.
Bro, it was mid. Ten on ten. Mid.
Let me ask Chat G. P. T. what's in this. ...It says 'PUP-poo'. Thanks, Chat G. P. T..
BOHN-daa? BOHN-daa! BOHN-daa!
The PUP-poo just gave me an okay sign. I'm out.
BAY-taa, even I don't eat my PUP-poo. And I put it in everything.

Office hours. Nobody ever comes, so the Prof has bought himself a cake. Prof Cake Count: zero. For now. The KUSS-ee is here with two coffees. One is for a fuh-CHEE who said she'd 'maybe come to office hours'. Nobody comes to office hours.
The Prof ate the cake. Hard work pays off. So do grants. (Cakes in my version don't count. As per rubric.)
CHIN-too ate the Prof's cake.
CHIN-too ate the Prof's cake. During office hours. Making CHIN-too the first person ever to attend them. Prof Cake Count: still zero. CHIN-too has been promoted.
And the KUSS-ee bonked CHIN-too. He says CHIN-too skipped the queue. There is no queue. There is no fuh-CHEE. There are two coffees.
And the Prof walked out of the comic. Office hours are now closed. Check MOO-dul for the new location.
The Prof ate his cake. Check MOO-dul for office hours.
Order is restored. I love order. I love rubrics.
A tidy ending. Typeset in LAY-tek.
Office hours. Nobody comes. More cake for me.
Wait. Someone is ATTENDING my office hours?
She said 'maybe'. Maybe is basically yes. It's been two hours.
Sir, small doubt, sir. Is 'maybe' a no?
I don't have a doubt. Please don't ask me a doubt.
Doubt: can I eat that? Doubt cleared.
First office hours I ever attended. Ten on ten.
